opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (A), up to £500 (B), up to £300 (C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending a UK conference).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior members at conferences (Society‑organised, non‑Society, or virtual) with travel, accommodation or registration support.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, provided they are studying or working in the UK, or the course is held in the UK. Students must be members; other applicants need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to support attendance at short training courses or collaborative visits to learn genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members can apply if they are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel, accommodation and consumables for field‑based genetic research projects suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs up to £1,000.
